name: TerrainData
signature: public sealed class TerrainData : Asset, ISerializable

docs.summary: Stores terrain heightmap, splatmap, detail layers, and tree data as a reusable asset. Referenced by TerrainComponent for rendering and TerrainCollider for physics.
Max value for 16-bit height storage.

Heightmap samples per side, one more than the number of cells it spans: 513 samples fence off 512 cells. Vertex grid, use [`HeightmapToUV`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TerrainData~HeightmapToUV) to convert an index to UV. Change it with [`ResizeHeightmap`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TerrainData~ResizeHeightmap), which reallocates to match.

Splatmap texels per side. Cell grid, so a texel sits in the middle of a heightmap cell, which is why it is one less than the heightmap. Use [`SplatmapToUV`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TerrainData~SplatmapToUV) to convert an index to UV, and [`ResizeSplatmap`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TerrainData~ResizeSplatmap) to change it.
Height interpolation mode for both CPU sampling and GPU shader.
Raw 16-bit heightmap. Values 0..kMaxHeight map to normalized 0..1. Use GetHeight/SetHeight for float access. Halves memory vs float[].

Interleaved splatmap weights. For N layers, each pixel has N floats. Layout: [pixel0_layer0, pixel0_layer1, ..., pixel0_layerN-1, pixel1_layer0, ...]. Length = SplatmapResolution * SplatmapResolution * LayerCount.
Dynamic layer list. Each group of 4 layers maps to one RGBA splatmap texture.
Per-pixel hole map at SplatmapResolution. 0 = hole (not rendered/no collision), 255 = solid. Null means no holes (all solid).

Detail cells per side, shared by all detail layers. Cell grid like the splatmap, use [`DetailToUV`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TerrainData~DetailToUV) to convert an index to UV, and [`ResizeDetailMaps`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TerrainData~ResizeDetailMaps) to change it.
Detail prototype definitions.

Per-prototype density maps. DetailLayers[protoIndex] = byte[DetailResolution * DetailResolution], where 0 is bare and 255 is solid. That is the resolution the GPU keeps anyway, and a quarter the memory of floats. Use GetDetailDensity/SetDetailDensity for 0-1 access. Array count matches DetailPrototypes.Count.
Bumped on every height change. Renderers watch this to rebuild cached data.
Bumped on every detail density change. Renderers watch this to rebuild cached data.
Bumped on every hole change. Renderers watch this to rebuild cached data.
Ensure DetailLayers array matches DetailPrototypes count.

Moves the payload of a freshly read copy into this object. The copy owns nothing afterwards.
